title: Personal Loans Credit Policy: Open Loans Held at One Time
content:
## Policy

A borrower may hold at most 2 Larkspur Personal Loans at the same time; loans in applied, approved or active status count toward the limit, while declined, withdrawn, expired, paid-off and settled loans do not. A refinance application does not count the active loan it will pay off, because that loan closes on the refinance funding date. The borrower holds fewer than the maximum number of open personal loans, not counting the loan a refinance application will pay off. No personal loan of the borrower is in charged-off status. An application that fails either condition is not taken, and the borrower is told which condition blocks it. The limit is counted per customer profile, not per household, address or bank account.

Both conditions are read from the borrower's loan records on the customer profile, before the application is taken.

## Which loans count

| Loan status on the profile | Counts toward the 2-loan limit |
|---|---|
| applied, approved, active | yes |
| declined, withdrawn, expired, paid off, settled | no |
| the active loan a refinance application will pay off | no |
| charged off | blocks every new application, whatever the count |

## Cases (hypothetical profiles)

- One active Personal Loans loan and nothing else: one open loan, fewer than 2, and no charged-off loan, so a new application is taken.
- One active loan and one approved offer not yet signed: two open loans, so a further application is not taken.
- Two active loans, applying to refinance one of them: the loan being paid off is not counted, one open loan remains, so the refinance application is taken.
- One paid-off loan and one charged-off loan: no open loan, but a charged-off loan blocks the application.
- Two borrowers at the same address, each with one active loan: each profile counts one open loan.
